UI SDK adds a little CSS of its own in a cascade layer named `ui-sdk`. Declare that layer at the top of your global stylesheet, above the Tailwind import, so your classes win over it.

With `hiddenUntilFound`, closed groups stay in the page, so the browser’s Find in Page can match Phobos and open Mars to show it.
With `mode="multiple"`, Cmd or Ctrl-click toggles an item and Shift extends a range. `expandOnPress={false}` leaves expanding to the chevron and the arrow keys.
`variant="lines"` draws an indent guide for each open group, and `size="sm"` makes the rows shorter.
